title: Flow Sort
body:
# Flow Sort

Flow Sort keeps your inventory organized automatically, without extra clicks.

Items are sorted as you play: new stacks settle into place, split stacks merge together, and your main inventory stays clean while your hotbar is left untouched.


## Automatic or manual

Prefer full control? Auto-sorting can be turned off at any time. You can still sort manually with buttons, middle-click, or a keybind.

## Features

- Automatic inventory sorting
- Manual sort buttons for vanilla chests and many chest-like modded storage screens
- Instant stack merging
- Sort opened chests and storage screens
- Middle-click sorting for the hovered inventory area
- Hotbar-safe sorting
- Simple configuration
- Clean compatibility with popular storage mods

## Sort as you loot
![Comfortable chest looting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a97a3407544987eedfbc59c549bf707f9c2adf9b.gif)

Open a chest and Flow Sort cleans it up instantly.
## Before / After
![Before](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7826ce2d70e5f42f90175d9784f2baf76c28b9ca.jpeg)

![After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec9312e708829a6799a13214450ebed53de8ba28.jpeg)
## Controls

- Middle mouse button: sort the inventory area under your cursor
- K: sort your inventory
- Buttons: sort manually or toggle auto-sorting

Keybinds can be changed in Minecraft's controls menu.

## Buttons

![Flow Sort buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5043df04323e00595346099d6e7c0a31af999b41.jpeg)

The check button toggles automatic sorting. The list button sorts the current inventory area instantly.

## Configuration

![Flow Sort settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd04199542525bd06242e983652aa3ed67e91a7e.png)

Flow Sort can be adjusted from the in-game config screen. On Fabric, this screen is available through Mod Menu.

- **Auto-sort my inventory**: automatically keeps your main inventory sorted.
- **Auto-sort opened chests**: sorts supported storage screens when you open or update them.
- **Show manual sort button**: shows the list button for instant manual sorting.
- **Show auto-toggle buttons**: shows the check button for quickly turning auto-sort on or off.
- **Show chest sort button**: shows a manual sort button for opened storage screens.
- **Show chest auto-toggle button**: shows an auto-sort toggle for opened storage screens.
- **Wait before auto-sort**: controls how long Flow Sort waits before sorting after changes.

## Compatibility

Flow Sort works client-side and supports vanilla chests, shulker boxes, and many chest-like modded storage screens.

If another mod already provides its own sorting buttons, Flow Sort avoids adding duplicate buttons where possible while keeping hotkeys and automatic sorting available.

## Requirements

- Fabric: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 
- Optional (Fabric): [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for in-game configuration on Fabric.
